rules.condition: rising edge of i_clk_wr with i_wr_en 1, o_full 0 and writes not blocked by software reset
rules.statement: A write shall be accepted and the word on i_wr_data stored at the next free place.

rules.condition: rising edge of i_clk_rd with i_rd_en 1, o_empty 0 and reads not blocked by software reset
rules.statement: A read shall be accepted, and the accepted word is the word shown on o_rd_data before that edge.

rules.condition: after an accepted read when another word is stored
rules.statement: o_rd_data shall show the next word (show-ahead) without a bubble.

rules.condition: every legal depth, data width, clock ratio, PARA_SFIFO_PTR_RETIME and memory option
rules.statement: Words shall be read in the order written, with no loss and no duplication.
The FIFO shall store up to PARA_SFIFO_DEPTH words and o_full shall be 1 when PARA_SFIFO_DEPTH words are stored.

rules.condition: a place is free but not yet visible in the write domain
rules.statement: o_full may be 1 while a place is free (conservative flag).
A write while o_full is 1 shall store nothing and leave the write pointer unchanged.

rules.condition: no stored word is visible to the read side
rules.statement: o_empty shall be 1 whenever no stored word is visible to the read side.

rules.condition: a word exists but is not yet visible in the read domain
rules.statement: o_empty may be 1 while a word exists (conservative flag).
o_rd_data shall be valid whenever o_empty is 0; it is not meaningful while o_empty is 1.
A read while o_empty is 1 shall leave the read pointer unchanged.
The depth shall be any integer of 2 or more.
Pointers shall count modulo two times the depth, and the memory address shall be the pointer modulo the depth.

rules.condition: occupancy seen by write side >= i_full_thr
rules.statement: o_full_thr shall be 1 when write-side occupancy is greater than or equal to i_full_thr.

rules.condition: occupancy seen by read side <= i_empty_thr
rules.statement: o_empty_thr shall be 1 when read-side occupancy is less than or equal to i_empty_thr.
i_full_thr and i_empty_thr shall be static inputs.

rules.condition: write requested while o_full was 1 and not blocked by software reset
rules.statement: o_overflow shall pulse for one write-clock cycle in the following cycle and not be sticky.

rules.condition: read requested while o_empty was 1 and not blocked by software reset
rules.statement: o_underflow shall pulse for one read-clock cycle in the following cycle and not be sticky.
A rejected write or read shall not change any pointer, stored word, or the occupancy.
The IP shall expose exactly the ports of Section 6.2, and the port list shall not depend on parameters except for widths.
Each listed output shall be driven by a flip-flop; the four flag outputs are combined with the software reset block term by one gate, with no other logic.
o_rd_data shall be the memory output register (one read-clock latency) with no logic after it and no reset.

rules.condition: clocks synchronous, any rational ratio, including coincident rising edges
rules.statement: The IP shall operate correctly with two synchronous clocks of any rational frequency ratio, including coinciding edges.
The IP shall contain no synchronizer and no clock-domain-crossing cell.
Every inter-domain path shall be an ordinary timed path closed by STA with no false-path or asynchronous clock-group exception.
The other domain's pointer shall enter the flag logic directly.
The other domain's pointer shall first be captured by one flip-flop in the destination domain.
The parameter shall change only flag latency and crossing-path timing, not function.
Both resets shall be active-low with asynchronous assertion.
Every flop of the domain shall be at reset value: pointers 0, o_full 0, o_empty 1, o_overflow 0, o_underflow 0, FSMs in RUN, o_sw_rst_busy 0, handshake flops 0.
Release of each hardware reset shall be synchronous to its domain clock and provided outside the IP.
The two resets shall be asserted together, and no operation shall start before both are released.
i_rst_n_sw = 0 shall request a software reset; one low cycle suffices.
A longer low level shall be held until the sequence reaches its hold state.

rules.condition: from the cycle in which i_rst_n_sw is 0
rules.statement: Writes shall be blocked with no clock delay: o_full 1, o_full_thr showing empty-FIFO value, and no write accepted.
Writes shall remain blocked until o_sw_rst_busy is 0.
A blocked write shall not raise o_overflow.

rules.condition: software reset request reaches the read side
rules.statement: Reads shall be blocked: o_empty 1, o_empty_thr 1, no read accepted until the read side is released.
A blocked read shall not raise o_underflow.
Read side shall reset its pointer first and acknowledge, then write side resets its pointer; read side is released first, write side last.
The software reset handshake shall be four-phase.
The FIFO shall be empty, both pointers 0, and every stored word discarded.
The memory content shall not be erased.
o_sw_rst_busy shall be a flip-flop output, 1 from the cycle after the write FSM takes the request until the cycle the write FSM is back in RUN.
The FIFO is ready for writes when o_sw_rst_busy is 0 and i_rst_n_sw is 1.
A hardware reset shall have priority over a software reset and bring both FSMs to RUN.

rules.condition: request arrives while a sequence is running
rules.statement: The request shall be served as a new sequence when the write FSM is back in RUN.

rules.condition: low level held in hold state
rules.statement: The sequence shall stay in the hold state.
The IP shall accept the parameter values listed in Section 8.
The IP shall accept one write per write-clock cycle and one read per read-clock cycle.

rules.condition: i_wr_en and i_rd_en held at 1, depth >= 4 + 2 x PARA_SFIFO_PTR_RETIME
rules.statement: There shall be only initial latency and no gap: every cycle where the other side is not limiting accepts a read or write.
o_empty shall fall after the first strictly later i_clk_rd rising edge (RETIME 0) or the second (RETIME 1), with o_rd_data showing the new word.
o_full shall fall after the first strictly later i_clk_wr rising edge (RETIME 0) or the second (RETIME 1).
o_full shall be 1 the cycle after the write storing the last free place; o_empty shall be 1 the cycle after the read taking the last word.
The RTL shall comply with REF-003 and use the hierarchy of Section 14.2.
The library SRAM shall be instantiated only inside the VLSIT_CELL_SRAM_1W1R wrapper in 000_Common, with instance name u_dont_touch_ plus function name, behaving like the array branch.
The IP shall contain no synchronizer module and no cell wrapper other than the SRAM wrapper; the retiming flop shall be a plain RTL flip-flop.
Every waveform of the plan shall exist as an image with WaveJSON source, reproducible by prototype scripts.
Scoreboard regression shall cover depths 2, 3, 5, 8, 12, both PARA_SFIFO_PTR_RETIME values and several clock ratios including equal, with no error.
